version: 0.1.0
kind: workspace-folder
metadata:
  name: .logs
  description: Volatile execution and validation logs retained outside the tracked workspace baseline.
spec:
  path: .workspace/.logs
  lifecycle: volatile
  tracking: ignored
  volatility: high
  naming:
    reserved_files:
      - _root.yaml
      - "*.log.yaml"
    versioning: semver
